table `dbcc_it_cat`.`items` -- items with everything

Columns
#  | Field      | Type                              | Null | Key | Default              | Extra                                        | Comment
---+------------+-----------------------------------+------+-----+----------------------+----------------------------------------------+--------------------
 1 | id         | int(10) unsigned                  | NO   | PRI |                      | auto_increment                               | surrogate key
 2 | code       | varchar(20)                       | NO   | MUL |                      |                                              |
 3 | region     | char(2)                           | NO   |     | 'EU'                 |                                              |
 4 | name       | varchar(200)                      | NO   | MUL |                      | COLLATE utf8mb4_bin                          |
 5 | note       | varchar(40)                       | YES  |     | 'NULL'               |                                              | string default NULL
 6 | nothing    | varchar(40)                       | YES  |     | NULL                 |                                              |
 7 | no_default | varchar(40)                       | NO   |     |                      |                                              |
 8 | empty_str  | varchar(10)                       | NO   |     | ''                   |                                              |
 9 | quote_str  | varchar(10)                       | NO   |     | 'it''s'              |                                              |
10 | price      | decimal(10,2)                     | NO   | MUL | 0.00                 |                                              |
11 | qty        | int(11)                           | NO   |     | 1                    |                                              |
12 | ratio      | double                            | YES  |     | -1.5                 |                                              |
13 | total      | decimal(12,2)                     | YES  | MUL |                      | GENERATED ALWAYS AS (`price` * `qty`) STORED |
14 | name_upper | varchar(200)                      | YES  |     |                      | GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ucase(`name`)) VIRTUAL  |
15 | status     | enum('new','active','it''s done') | NO   |     | 'new'                |                                              |
16 | tags       | set('a','b','c')                  | YES  |     | NULL                 |                                              |
17 | uid        | varchar(36)                       | NO   |     | uuid()               |                                              |
18 | created    | datetime                          | NO   |     | current_timestamp()  |                                              |
19 | updated    | timestamp(3)                      | NO   |     | current_timestamp(3) | on update current_timestamp(3)               |
20 | small      | tinyint(1)                        | NO   |     | 0                    |                                              |
21 | data       | blob                              | YES  |     | NULL                 |                                              |
22 | bin        | varbinary(16)                     | YES  |     | NULL                 |                                              |
23 | doc        | longtext                          | YES  |     | NULL                 | COLLATE utf8mb4_bin                          |
24 | parent_a   | int(11)                           | YES  | MUL | NULL                 |                                              |
25 | parent_b   | varchar(20)                       | YES  |     | NULL                 |                                              |

Primary and unique keys
Key         | Name           | Columns
------------+----------------+-------------
PRIMARY KEY | PRIMARY        | id
UNIQUE      | uq_code_region | code, region

Foreign keys
Name            | Columns            | References                    | On update | On delete
----------------+--------------------+-------------------------------+-----------+----------
fk_items_parent | parent_a, parent_b | `dbcc_it_cat`.`parent` (a, b) | RESTRICT  | CASCADE

Check constraints
Name      | Expression        | Enforced
----------+-------------------+---------
chk_code  | `code` <> ''      | YES
chk_price | `price` >= 0      | YES
doc       | json_valid(`doc`) | YES
qty       | `qty` < 100000    | YES

Indexes
Name           | Columns            | Unique | Type     | Visible | Comment
---------------+--------------------+--------+----------+---------+--------
PRIMARY        | id                 | YES    | BTREE    | YES     |
ft_name        | name               | NO     | FULLTEXT | YES     |
ix_name_prefix | name(10)           | NO     | BTREE    | YES     |
ix_parent      | parent_a, parent_b | NO     | BTREE    | YES     |
ix_price_desc  | price DESC, qty    | NO     | BTREE    | YES     |
ix_total       | total              | NO     | BTREE    | YES     |
uq_code_region | code, region       | YES    | BTREE    | YES     |

Triggers
